A portal tears open mid-hunt and Ghislaine — a beast-race swordswoman from another world — catches the scent of a strong male. Giyu unveils his Eleventh Form: Mating Breathing. Six loads deep in the moonlit forest, she claims him as her mate~ Patreon Tier Commission. comic by Amadeus V.
